meta.name: content-angle-ranker
meta.description: Rank content angles by engagement data, competition level, and platform fit. Data-driven angle selection instead of guesswork. Use this skill when the user has a keyword or product and needs to decide WHAT to create, which angle to take, which format to use, or which platform to target. Triggers on: "what angle should I use", "rank content ideas for [keyword]", "best angle for [product]", "which content idea will perform best", "help me pick an angle", "what should I write about", "content angle for [topic]", "rank my content ideas", "which approach will get the most views", "data-driven content planning", "angle ranker", "content scoring", "which hook should I use", "compare these content ideas", "prioritize my content angles", "what video should I make".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用数据排名内容角度，找到最佳创作方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做内容营销却总靠直觉选选题
copy.tagline_en: Rank content angles with data to find the best direction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do content marketing but always pick angles by gut

howto.what: 收到关键词或产品后，Claude会搜索并分析竞争数据、参与度等，生成8-12个内容角度候选，并按平台适配、竞争程度、互动预测等维度评分排序，最后输出最优推荐。
howto.when: 当你询问“用什么角度”、“排内容角度”等，或有关键词但不确定创作方向时触发。也适合在trending-content-scout运行后使用其数据。

say.text: 为关键词'AI视频工具'排内容角度，平台TikTok。
我有三个内容想法，帮我按数据优先排序。

howto.what_en: Given a keyword or product, Claude searches and analyzes competition and engagement data, generates 8-12 content angle candidates, scores them on platform fit, competition, engagement prediction, and creator fit, then ranks and recommends the best.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about angles, request ranking for a keyword, or have a keyword but lack content direction. Also suitable after running trending-content-scout.

say_en.text: Rank content angles for 'AI video tools' on TikTok.
I have three content ideas. Prioritize them by data.
